heading.title: First Division · Part VIII · Suits Relating to Trusts and Trust Property

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
To set aside a transfer of movable property comprised in a Hindu, Muslim or Buddhist religious or charitable endowment, made by a manager thereof for a valuable consideration.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the transfer becomes known to the plaintiff.
